BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Doors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Doors.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Doors.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Doors.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Doors.

2. When learning Construction Hand Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Hand Power Tools.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Hand Power Tools.

3. When learning Domestic Water Supply, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Domestic Water Supply.

7. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Information and Communication Technology

8. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

9. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Windows.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Sanitary Appliances and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Drainage Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Building Construction Project and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Construction Hand Power Tools and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
